description.to:
Why: "sign up, pay and you have a website" needs a provisioning workflow, a starter site, onboarding, lifecycle states and complete export and deletion. The existing stories PPY-8bb56d (provisioning API), PPY-8e6c06 (export and deletion), PPY-bd1c6e (payment lifecycle) and PPY-e54eca (sign-up to live site) state the behaviour; the tasks in this epic implement them with exact files, models and order. Billing itself is Prospectus's (epic PPY-e0fd12 and Papyrus wait task PPY-a1e75a).

Owner decisions that bind it (2026-11-07): no free plan and no trial; usage pricing through Prospectus; custom domains in every plan; tenants own 100% of their content.

Done when: in staging a paid sign-up reaches a live site and an admin sign-in with no human step, a suspended tenant is read-only and can export, and a deleted tenant leaves nothing behind (proved by the export/delete tests). Ends with a p.apyr.us page.
